metadata.name: Hide Cursor
metadata.description: Hides the mouse cursor by default. Restores a white/red crosshair only when MouseControl=1 and you hold mouse-aim items (Epic Fetus, Ludovico, etc.). Keyboard/controller (MouseControl off): no change. 中文：默认隐藏；仅鼠标模式+瞄准道具时显示准星。日本語：デフォルト非表示。MouseControl=1かつ照準アイテム時のみ表示。Source: https://github.com/MinuteReversal/hide-cursor-mod
